product.name: Monoprice Premium Full Motion TV Wall Mount Bracket For 37 To 70 TVs up to 77lbs Max VESA 600x400
product.description: The Monoprice™ Full Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount Bracket focuses on a minimal footprint on the wall. Minimizing the amount of space required for mounting allows for optimal mounting positioning. The single arm design allows for a greater range of side to side motion. The large TV plate design accommodates a large variety of screen sizes including large format, lightweight displays. *Note that the display screen size is only an approximation. Your display is compatible with this mount as long as it has a VESA® mounting pattern and weight that fit within the size and weight limits listed above. Support Files: User's Manual (Mar 06, 2022)Diagram (May 21, 2025)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
